thread:
marta: Noticed spike in 400s during v2 shift, looks like legacy SDKs are sending X-API-Version:2 while using 1.0 user-agent. Gateway rejects.

leo: Can you paste a sample log line?

marta: sample from proxy:
`{"ts":"2026-03-20T22:12:10Z","tenant":"partner-beta","path":"/api/generate","headers":{"X-API-Version":"2","User-Agent":"partner-sdk/1.0.0"},"resp_status":400}`

deploy-bot: Created alert route-6123459999-gateway-400s value=1.3% threshold=0.5% window=5m

sasha: This matches a known SDK normalization bug on 1.0. Mitigation: pause the shift, pin affected tenants, rollback some traffic to v1.

dmitri: Agreed. Actions: 1) pause shift job, 2) pin partner-beta and partner-gamma, 3) set v2 target to 30% to reduce error surface, 4) notify integrations + CS. Rollback trigger: 400_rate>1% for 3m or p95 latency>200ms.

leo: I'll draft a short tenant email and release-note addendum (PR WIP).

marta: Running commands now:
`/deploybot pin add partner-beta partner-gamma`
`/deploybot shift update shift-job-6123459999 --target v2=30`

deploy-bot: pin add -> OK; shift update accepted -> v2=30%; paused further auto-increase

sasha: We'll schedule a gateway shim (header-coerce) patch next week. For now keep EU excluded until partners confirm SDK upgrades.

dmitri: CS notified when pins applied. Leo, subject: "Temporary pause in v2 rollout — legacy SDKs". Include instructions: upgrade SDK or set header to 1.

leo: Draft posted to #customer-success and pinged partner POCs.

deploy-bot: Snapshot at 6123460105: v2=30%, pins=[partner-beta,partner-gamma], paused=true, alert route-6123459999 reduced to 0.4%

marta: Stable for now. We'll keep shift paused and run postmortem tomorrow with SDK owners. If anything changes escalate to @oncall and open incident channel #release-ops.

dmitri: Closing ops thread, keep updates here.
